internships.desc: Real-time Industry opportunity in developing bank software
responsibilities: Deliver reliable and well-tested features.
Collaborate with multi-functional engineering teams.
requirements: Strong problem-solving fundamentals.

internships.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
internships.desc: Build scalable dashboard interfaces, optimize GraphQL/REST pipelines, and create real-time collaboration engines using modern web standards.
responsibilities: Design and implement responsive React modules adhering to atomic design standards.
Develop high-performance REST APIs with Node.js and FastAPI.
Collaborate closely with product designers and senior platform engineers.
requirements: Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript / TypeScript and React.
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and relational databases.
Strong understanding of component modularity and REST APIs.

internships.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
internships.desc: Train deep neural networks for multi-modal perception, object tracking, and edge inference on mobile robotic platforms.
responsibilities: Curate and augment multi-spectral visual datasets.
Optimize neural net architectures for low-latency edge deployment.
Document ablation studies and benchmark model throughput.
requirements: Proficiency in Python and PyTorch / TensorFlow.
Solid foundations in linear algebra, statistics, and neural networks.
Prior coursework or personal projects in computer vision.

internships.title: Cloud DevOps & Platform Intern
internships.desc: Deploy resilient CI/CD pipelines, containerize microservices, and manage telemetry monitoring metrics across multi-region Kubernetes clusters.
responsibilities: Automate deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and Helm charts.
Provision cloud resources using Terraform infrastructure-as-code.
Configure Prometheus and Grafana alerts for microservice latency.
requirements: Comfortable with Linux CLI and shell scripting.
Experience building and running Docker containers.
Familiarity with cloud concepts on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

internships.title: UI/UX Design Systems Intern
internships.desc: Develop atomic design component libraries, run user testing interviews, and engineer pixel-perfect interactive high-fidelity user workflows.
responsibilities: Construct responsive component libraries in Figma with auto-layout.
Create wireframes and interactive prototypes for web and mobile.
Conduct usability audits and hand off design tokens to front-end teams.
requirements: Demonstrated Figma portfolio showing design system thinking.
Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).
Foundational knowledge of CSS flexbox and responsive layouts.

internships.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Intern
internships.desc: Architect high-throughput ETL data pipelines, transaction aggregation warehouses, and automated real-time financial reporting analytics.
responsibilities: Write complex SQL queries and optimize analytical warehouse schemas.
Build automated batch and streaming ingestion pipelines with Python.
Maintain data cataloging, validation tests, and governance rules.
requirements: Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL / MySQL and SQL window functions.
Experience with Python data libraries (Pandas, Polars).
Analytical problem-solving and algorithmic thinking.

internships.title: Cybersecurity & SOC Analyst Intern
internships.desc: Audit cloud infrastructure configurations, perform automated vulnerability scans, and implement zero-trust defense access policies.
responsibilities: Analyze security telemetry logs and investigate anomaly alerts.
Conduct baseline vulnerability scans and assist in threat modeling.
Develop automated security auditing scripts using Python.
requirements: Knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI model, and standard cryptographic protocols.
Hands-on experience with Linux environments and basic bash scripting.
Security certifications (CompTIA Security+, CEH) are a plus.
